contact_email.description: Email address used to register with the ACME CA. Required by Let's Encrypt.

base_dir.description: Root directory for storing certificates, accounts, and registration data.

wellknown_dir.description: Web-accessible directory used to serve HTTP-01 challenge files.

key_algo.description: Algorithm for the private key. Options: rsa, ecdsa.

key_size.description: Key size in bits — only used when key_algo=rsa.

pfs.description: Key type for Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) in ECDSA keys. Options: ec-256, ec-384, rsa-2048.

ca.description: Which ACME CA to use. Options: letsencrypt, letsencrypt-staging, zerossl.

hooks.description: List of absolute paths to hook scripts (e.g., deploy, reload, notify).

dns_hooks.description: List of DNS hook scripts (for DNS-01 challenge automation).

standalone_enabled.description: If true, dehydrated will start a temporary HTTP server during HTTP-01 challenges instead of using webroot.

standalone_port.description: HTTP port for the standalone server. Set to 0 to disable (e.g., if already running another service).

san_domains.description: Additional domains (SANs) to include in each certificate alongside the main one.

challenge_type.description: Default ACME challenge type to use. Options: http-01, dns-01, tls-alpn-01.

no_renewal_check.description: Set to true to disable automatic renewal checks (e.g., if using systemd timers externally).

user_agent.description: User-Agent string to present to the ACME CA. Recommended to keep default or include version.

ca_bundle.description: Absolute path to a custom CA bundle (e.g., for ZeroSSL or internal CA). Leave empty for system default.
